scope: Complete C210 affected cohort defined as every method in the 18 named preexisting modules, plus the new sidecar module. No cherry-picking by result.

Original 43 source cases; actual local-driver source role can satisfy this without a duplicate invocation.
Preservation/navigation check; actual local-driver documents role can satisfy this.
54 real Agent workflow checks and exact before/after/rejected source/artifact preservation evidence already separately bound.
Pinned Khronos/Three.js checks on actual C210 artifacts, distinct from retained C20 release metadata.

coverage_reconciliation_rule: Bind each candidate source/test hash to an observed completed unittest method outcome from the mandatory driver or a separately recorded focused run. An AST ID is not a test pass. Missing, skipped, failed, errored or timed-out methods remain explicit. Run only missing affected IDs or concrete failure-resolution controls, keeping original outcomes.
inherited_global_failure_rule: Preserve the inherited failed/unrun full regression and any new mandatory-driver failure as distinct observations. This affected cohort is not a full-suite pass and does not waive newly introduced or worsened failures.

excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.scope: Torque, reach, force, surface, texture and other source/Agent/GLB profile suites
excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.reason: No implementation bytes or profile contracts changed; the new sidecar rejects these profiles. Their mandatory-driver outcomes and historical failures remain visible; do not rerun them merely to improve a global count.

excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.scope: CLI wrappers and formal evidence-gate checker unit modules outside the listed cohort
excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.reason: The new entry points are opt-in Python APIs plus a separate driver; no existing CLI or gate-checker machinery changed. Mandatory-driver executions still apply and remain separately recorded.

excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.scope: C201 native admission, C199/C200 transactions and closed schedules
excluded_from_extra_affected_reruns.reason: Outside authorization for this milestone; ordinary C210 GLB checks do not execute or reopen them.

limitations: Inventory establishes expected coverage only; observed test execution must be reconciled separately.
Approval of this finite increment cannot establish complete release acceptance, broad application integration, live physics or authoring advantage.
